problem:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the finite region bounded between the ellipses $(x-1)^{2}+4{y}^{2}=1$ and ${x}^{2}+4{y}^{2}=4?$

- It is a type I region
- It is a type II region
- It's neither a type I nor a type II region
worked_solution:
First, let's sketch our region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14038811/assets/215dd0c920e700a75896fc54751ec20d197487a2c992cd8910810c66129c14dc.png)

We have the following:

- The vertical line $x=1$ intersects the region in two separate intervals, as shown below. So, this can't be a type I region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14038811/assets/7e1a0c5dd2b4aadf7efe78d903234b8d00cf4fa92eb7a3b41209a856f2d14b01.png)

- The horizontal line $y=0.25$ intersects the region in two separate intervals, as shown below. So, this can't be a type II region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14038811/assets/a90d7306e3f88a31609e368f9362248d6a12b7922b6a9e8c9f980ab31e7fb140.png)

Therefore, only statement III is true.
